instalator.gotowe1: WalkLevel {wersja} will be installed on this computer.
instalator.gotowe2: Click Install. Administrator rights are not needed, and WalkLevel opens by itself after installation.
instalator.languages: Choose the languages of WalkLevel. English is built in. You can change the language later in Settings > Language.
instalator.webview2-missing: WalkLevel needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 for its window, and it is missing. Install it from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/ and start WalkLevel again.
